27/S0.subgoal: Explain why understanding visual perception, light propagation, and lenses is important for VR headset design, virtual world rendering, camera placement, and tracking.

27/S1.subgoal: Describe the three models of light—photons, waves, and rays—and the visual phenomena each model helps explain.

27/S2.subgoal: Explain how light rays interact with material surfaces through transmission, absorption, and reflection.

27/S3.subgoal: Explain how perceived color is determined by the intensity of direct and ambient reflected light reaching the eye.

27/S4.subgoal: Describe the structure and function of the human eye, including refraction, photoreceptor types, and photopic versus scotopic vision.

27/S5.subgoal: Explain the visible light spectrum in terms of frequency and wavelength and how it excites cones to produce photopic color vision.

27/S6.subgoal: Describe central and peripheral vision based on retinal photoreceptor distribution and explain the blind spot caused by optic nerve anatomy.

27/S7.subgoal: Summarize the main points of the lecture and preview the next part on headsets and displays.
